_about: Public-domain Miguel de Molinos (1628-1696, Spanish priest condemned as a Quietist) in English for the Word Hoard: The Spiritual Guide in the English version of 1688, translated from the Venice edition of 1685, and the Leeds revision of 1775, from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 24 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

molinos-spiritual-guide-1688: The Spiritual Guide which Disentangles the Soul, with a Short Treatise concerning Daily Communion, translated from the Italian copy printed at Venice 1685 (London, catalogued 1688)
molinos-spiritual-guide-1775: The Spiritual Guide, carefully revised with the original (Leeds: J. Bowling, M.DCC.LXXV)

_alternates.molinos-ccel-guide: CCEL molinos/guide: the 1688 text, but CCEL states a Methuen 1907 source it does not carry
_alternates.molinos-copies: The other 1688 copy (bim_..._the-spiritual-guide-whic_molinos-miguel-de_1688), the 1699 printing, and the 1885 Philadelphia and Glasgow reprints of 1699
_alternates.molinos-extracts: Golden Thoughts from The Spiritual Guide, preface by J. H. Shorthouse (1883), and two eighteenth-century abstracts

_excluded.molinos-baillie: Thoughts and Aphorisms (1857): its title page does not name Molinos
_excluded.molinos-about: Bigelow (1882) and other works about him; Italian and Spanish editions
